blocks.tamil_translation: fulfil their oath” — Hazrat Anas (RA) narrates that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say this.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- The meaning of this hadith: if any servant among the servants of Allah Ta'ala is seen dirty and with dishevelled hair, one should not regard him as lower than oneself. Many who are in this state are special servants of Allah Ta'ala. It should be understood that the purpose of the hadith is not to encourage a servant to be dishevelled and dirty.
(Ma'ariful Hadith)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدِ نِ السَّاعِدِيِّ ﵁ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: مَرَّ رَجُلٌ عَلَي رَسُولِ اللهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ لِرَجُلٍ عِنْدَهُ جَالِسٍ: مَارَأْيُكَ فِي هذَا؟ فَقَالَ: رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَشْرَافِ النَّاسِ، هذَا وَاللهِ حَرِيٌّ إِنْ خَطَبَ أَنْ يُنْكَحَ، وَإِنْ شَفَعَ أَنْ يُشَفَّعَ، قَالَ: فَسَكَتَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ ثُمَّ مَرَّ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَا رَأْيُكَ فِي هذَا؟ فَقَالَ: يَارَسُولَ اللهِ! هذَا رَجُلٌ مِنْ فُقَرَاءِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، هذَا حَرِيٌّ إِنْ خَطَبَ أَنْ لَاَ يُنْكَحَ، وَإِنْ شَفَعَ أَنْ لَاَ يُشَفَّعَ، وَإِنْ قَالَ أَنْ لَاَ يُسْمَعَ لِقَوْلِهِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: هذَا خَيْرٌ مِنْ مِلْءِ الأَرْضِ مِثْلَ هذَا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب فضل الفقر رقم:٦٤٤٧
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Sahl ibn Sa'd Sa'idi (RA) narrates: A man passed by Rasulullah ﷺ, and the Prophet ﷺ asked a person sitting near him, ”What is your opinion of this man?” He said, “He is one of the honourable people. By Allah! If he asks anyone for a woman's hand, she will be given to him in marriage. If he intercedes for anyone, he is worthy of having his intercession accepted.” Hearing this, the Prophet ﷺ remained silent. After
